title: Snyk repository access file
description: Declares who has access to the Snyk Organization a repository maps to. Lives at .github/snyk-access.yaml.

id.description: Snyk Organization ID. When omitted, the Snyk Organization is resolved from the repository URL through the Asset Search API.

org_admins.description: Users who receive the Org Admin role.

users.description: Users who receive the developer role defined in the Snyk Group.

email.description: Email address on the user's Snyk account.
